description: Live grid scoreboard: US grid operators (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE, BPA, TVA), Great Britain, European bidding zones, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea and Brazil, ranked side by side on each feed's latest published reading: renewable share (wind+solar+hydro), gas share, fuel mix in MW and demand, greenest first. Freshness differs by feed, so read each row's mix_age_hours before calling a reading current. No arguments. Answers "which grid is cleanest right now".
